# Bridge UI (monorepo)

> Source repository for `@bridge-ui/core`, `@bridge-ui/react`, and `@bridge-ui/vue`.

## Packages

- packages/react — React components (+ transitive `@bridge-ui/core`)
- packages/vue — Vue components (+ transitive `@bridge-ui/core`)
- packages/core — types, tokens, utils

## AI resources (consume the library — live in each package)

- packages/react/ai/AGENTS.md
- packages/react/ai/llms.txt
- packages/react/ai/guidelines/core.md
- packages/react/ai/skills/*/SKILL.md
- packages/vue/ai/AGENTS.md
- packages/vue/ai/llms.txt
- packages/vue/ai/guidelines/core.md
- packages/vue/ai/skills/*/SKILL.md

Consumer install:

```bash
npx bridge-ui-react-ai install
npx bridge-ui-vue-ai install
```

## Monorepo agent entry

- AGENTS.md

## Human docs

- docs/README.md
- docs/react/
- docs/vue/
